LanguageData.ESCP_CollegeOfWinterhold_Enlist_Letter_L: Your colony now stands with the College of Winterhold. Open the guild ledger at any settlement hosting them to draw pay, take work and see your standing.
LanguageData.ESCP_CollegeOfWinterhold_Enlist_Button_D: Seek admission to the College of Winterhold, Skyrim's last great seat of magical learning.
LanguageData.ESCP_CollegeOfWinterhold_Enlist_Requreme: The College of Winterhold does not trust you yet. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_CollegeOfWinterhold_Enlisted_To_Hos: You cannot join the College of Winterhold while your colony is at odds with it.
LanguageData.ESCP_CollegeOfWinterhold_Enlisted_With_K: Member of the College of Winterhold
LanguageData.ESCP_CollegeOfWinterhold_Missions_Desc: See what work the guild has posted.
LanguageData.ESCP_CollegeOfWinterhold_Menu_Missions_D: Open contracts posted by the College of Winterhold. Accepting one costs nothing; payment comes when it is done.
LanguageData.ESCP_CollegeOfWinterhold_Salary_Desc: Collect your share from the guild's steward.
LanguageData.ESCP_CollegeOfWinterhold_Provisions_Desc: Take what the guild sets aside for its members on the road.
LanguageData.ESCP_CollegeOfWinterhold_Storage_Desc: Leave goods in the guild's keeping and collect them from any hall.
LanguageData.ESCP_CollegeOfWinterhold_Resign_Menu_Tex: Leave the College of Winterhold? Your standing will suffer for it.
LanguageData.ESCP_CollegeOfWinterhold_Resign_Letter_L: Your colony has left the College of Winterhold. Its doors are closed to you for now.
LanguageData.ESCP_CollegeOfWinterhold_Resign_Button_D: Give up your membership and every rank that goes with it.
LanguageData.ESCP_CollegeOfWinterhold_Kick_Out_Letter: Expelled from the College of Winterhold
LanguageData.ESCP_CollegeOfWinterhold_Kick_Out_Label_: Relations have fallen too far. The College of Winterhold has struck your colony from its books.
LanguageData.ESCP_CollegeOfWinterhold_Work_0_Desc: Help the archivist keep track of a library that resents being organized.
LanguageData.ESCP_CollegeOfWinterhold_Work_1_Desc: Read long into the cold nights.
